description: Land Title Registration Department - :Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 1473/33, D/S Division, Homagama - C. M. No. 520003 and Other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically amending the registration details for specific parcels of land (No. 32 and No. 34 of Block 01) by inserting right of way information. It falls under the Registration of Title Act and involves cadastral mapping, property boundaries, and land encumbrances - all characteristic of Land Gazettes (Type 4). There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and the specialized land focus clearly distinguishes it from other categories.
